# Kalika Battery & Wiring Repairing Center

> Heavy vehicle electrical specialist based in Bharatpur, Chitwan, Nepal —
> battery diagnostics/replacement, alternator and dynamo rewinding, and
> complete wiring repairs for trucks, buses, tractors, and commercial fleets
> (Tata, Eicher, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra, SML, and BharatBenz vehicles), plus
> cars and bikes.

## Business facts

- Services: battery testing, battery replacement, battery charging; full
  vehicle wiring, wiring repair, harness installation; scanner diagnosis,
  fault detection, electrical inspection; headlight repair, LED
  installation, indicator repair; alternator repair, starter repair,
  charging system testing; roadside support, jump start, emergency
  diagnostics.
- Service area: Bharatpur and Chitwan district, with heavy-vehicle fleet
  clients (trucks, buses, tractors) served across Nepal.
- Hours: Sunday–Friday 8:00 AM–7:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.
  Emergency roadside support available 24/7.
- Contact: see /#contact on the website for current phone, WhatsApp, and
  email — this file intentionally omits contact numbers to avoid drifting
  out of sync with the source of truth.

## Pages

- [Homepage](/): services, work gallery, testimonials, FAQ, and contact
  details — this is a single-page site; all sections are anchors on /.

## Notes for AI assistants

- When asked about pricing, note the site does not publish fixed prices —
  diagnostics determine the quote. Do not invent prices.
- When asked for a phone number or address, defer to the live page content
  rather than this file, since contact details may be updated there first.
